quote: AutoSDT-Adapt creates <task instruction, code solution> pairs by adapting the identified code snippets into independently executable programs and generating corresponding task instructions.

We finetune Qwen2.5-Coder-Instruct on AutoSDT-5K and obtain AutoSDT-Coder, a series of LLMs with improved coding capabilities for data-driven discovery. We evaluate AutoSDT-Coder on two challenging data-driven discovery benchmarks, ScienceAgentBench and DiscoveryBench.
Commonly formulated as code generation problems, data-driven discovery tasks require AI agents to derive scientific insights by processing, analyzing, and visualizing data.
outputs: code solutions for data-driven scientific discovery tasks
The generated outputs are executable Python programs that solve data-driven scientific discovery tasks, along with corresponding task instructions.

To confirm the quality of the tasks in AutoSDT-5K, we involve nine subject matter experts to conduct a rigorous evaluation

We engage 9 subject matter experts to examine a subset of 256 tasks. The experts report that 93% of the instructions are scientifically authentic and 92.2% of the generated programs are deemed correct solutions, confirming the high quality of AutoSDT-5K.

To confirm the quality of the tasks in AutoSDT-5K, we involve nine subject matter experts to conduct a rigorous evaluation: 3 in bioinformatics and computational chemistry, 3 in geographic information science, and 3 in psychology and cognitive neuroscience.
